name: apple-mail-mcp
description: Search, read, compose, triage, organize and analyze Apple Mail on macOS.
long_description: Natural language interface for Apple Mail with 28 tools: email search, reading, composition, bulk operations, smart inbox analytics, folder management and safety-checked destructive operations. Runs locally and talks only to Mail.app.

user_preferences.title: Email Preferences
user_preferences.description: Your personal email preferences that will be provided to the AI assistant when using email tools (e.g., 'Default to BCG account, show max 50 emails, prefer Archive folder')

tools.name: compose_email
tools.description: Compose and send a new email from a specific account.

tools.name: create_mailbox
tools.description: Create a new mailbox (folder) in the specified account.

tools.name: create_rich_email_draft
tools.description: Create a rich-text email draft by generating an unsent `.eml` message and optionally opening it in Mail.

tools.name: export_emails
tools.description: Export emails to files for backup or analysis.

tools.name: forward_email
tools.description: Forward an email to one or more recipients.

tools.name: get_awaiting_reply
tools.description: Find sent emails that haven't received a reply yet.

tools.name: get_email_source
tools.description: Return the raw RFC 822 source of a single message.

tools.name: get_email_thread
tools.description: Get an email conversation thread - messages linked by Message-ID, not just by subject.

tools.name: get_inbox_overview
tools.description: Get a comprehensive overview of your email inbox status across all accounts.

tools.name: get_mailbox_unread_counts
tools.description: Get unread counts per mailbox for one account or all accounts.

tools.name: get_needs_response
tools.description: Identify unread emails that likely need a response from you.

tools.name: get_statistics
tools.description: Get comprehensive email statistics and analytics.

tools.name: get_top_senders
tools.description: Analyse a mailbox to find the most frequent senders.

tools.name: inbox_dashboard
tools.description: Get an interactive dashboard view of your email inbox.

tools.name: list_account_addresses
tools.description: List all configured email addresses for each Mail account.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: List all available Mail accounts.

tools.name: list_email_attachments
tools.description: List attachments for emails matching a subject keyword.

tools.name: list_inbox_emails
tools.description: List all emails from inbox across all accounts or a specific account.

tools.name: list_mailboxes
tools.description: List all mailboxes (folders) for a specific account or all accounts.

tools.name: manage_drafts
tools.description: Manage draft emails - list, create, send, open, or delete drafts.

tools.name: manage_trash
tools.description: Manage trash operations - delete emails or empty trash.

tools.name: move_email
tools.description: Move email(s) matching filters from one mailbox to another.

tools.name: read_email
tools.description: Read headers, plain-text body and attachment metadata for one message.

tools.name: reply_to_email
tools.description: Reply to an email matching a subject keyword.

tools.name: save_email_attachment
tools.description: Save a specific attachment from an email to disk.

tools.name: search_emails
tools.description: Unified search tool with JSON output, pagination, and real date filtering.

tools.name: synchronize_account
tools.description: Force Mail.app to synchronize an account (or every account) with its IMAP / Exchange server right now. Equivalent to clicking the refresh button next to the account or selecting Mailbox → Synchronize.

tools.name: update_email_status
tools.description: Update email status - mark as read/unread or flag/unflag emails.
